pages.title: Pavojingos medžiagos
pages.text: Kai kurios $(thing)rudos$(), $(thing)dulkes$() ir $(thing)chemines medžiagos$() yra pavojingos ir jei jas nešiojate savo inventoriuje, gali sukelti $(item)neigiamus poveikius$() ar netgi $(item)nužudyti$() Jus. Kai juos nešiojate, ekrane rodoma $(item)poveikio būsena$().$(br2)Tam tikra įranga, pavyzdžiui, $(thing)kaukės$(), $(thing)pirštinės$() ir $(thing)apsauginis kostiumas nuo pavojingų medžiagų$() gali būti naudojami šiems poveikiams neutralizuoti.

pages.text: $(li)$(l:game_mechanics/hazards#containers)Containers$()$(li)$(l:game_mechanics/hazards#mask)Face Mask$()$(li)$(l:game_mechanics/hazards#gloves)Rubber Gloves$()$(li)$(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$()$(li)$(l:game_mechanics/hazards#medicine)Pills, Tablets and Salvos$()$(li)$(l:game_mechanics/hazards#rad_away)RadAwayᵗᵐ Pill$()$(li)$(l:game_mechanics/hazards#respawn)The Unthinkable...$()

pages.title: Konteineriai
pages.text: Hazardous materials only deal damage while they are in your $(thing)inventory$(), but that doesn't apply to other containers!$(br)Hazardous materials will not deal damage while they are in another container such as a $(l:logistics/personal_storage)Backpack$() or $(l:craftsmanship/pottery#vessel)Vessel$(). $(item)$(k:key.use)$() while holding a vessel will allow direct transfer of its contents to and from containers.

pages.title: Veido kaukė
pages.text: $(thing)Veido kaukė$() suteikia apsaugą nuo bet kokių $(item)Įkvepiamų$() pavojų, pavyzdžiui: arsenozės.

pages.title: Rubber Gloves
pages.text: The $(thing)Rubber gloves$() can either be made from $(l:agriculture/leather_making)Leather$() and $(thing)Latex$(), or out of $(thing)Rubber Sheets$(). They provide protection from any $(item)Skin Contact$() hazards, such as $(thing)Beryllium Dust$().

pages.title: Apsauginis kostiumas
pages.text: A completed $(thing)Hazmat suit $()provides $(item)immunity $()from $(item)every$() hazard, even $(item)radiation$(). It is made mostly from $(thing)Rubber$() and $(thing)Polyvinyl Chloride$().$(br2)$(bold)TIP$(): You can also look up $(6)#ppe_armor$() in $(emi) for more equipment that provides protection from hazardous materials.

pages.title: Medicina
pages.text: In case you do get heavily exposed to a hazard, there are some $(item)Medicines$() that can help you recover.$(br2)Basic $(item)Pills$() are the most primitive and easy to make, but most come with $(thing)Negative Side Effects$(). $(item)Tablets$() and $(item)Salvos$() are more effective and have less side effects, but they require $(thing)LV equipment$() and more advanced resources to make.

pages.title: „RadAwayᵗᵐ“ tabletė
pages.text: Tai yra $(item)galutinis$() vaistas, skirtas $(item)VISIEMS$() pavojams ir yra $(item)VIENINTELIS$() veiksmingas vaistas nuo $(item)Spinduliuotės/Radiacijos$(). Tačiau tai taip pat yra $(thing)brangiausias$() ir $(thing)sunkiausiai$() pagaminamas daiktas, kuriam reikia $(thing)„HV“ pakopos įrangos ir pažangių medžiagų.

pages.title: Nesėkmė...
pages.text: If all else fails, bringing along a bed to respawn is a good idea.$(br2)If you don't have access to $(item)Wool$() or $(item)String$(), you can also make a $(thing)Thatch Bed$().

pages.title: Arsenicosis
pages.text: $(thing)Arsenicosis$() is an illness caused by inhaling $(thing)Arsenic$() from its dust, vapor or $(thing)Realgar$(). It slowly increases hunger, followed by nausea, and eventually $(bold)death$().$(br2)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#mask)Face Mask$() and the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$() provide protection from $(thing)Arsenicosis$().

pages.title: Asbestosis
pages.text: $(thing)Asbestosis$() is an illness caused by inhaling $(thing)Asbestos$() dust. If carried for long enough, it causes hunger.$(br2)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#mask)Face Mask$() and the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$() provide protection from $(thing)Asbestosis$().

pages.title: Berylliosis
pages.text: $(thing)Berylliosis$() is an illness caused by skin contact with $(thing)Beryllium dust$() or $(thing)Liquid Beryllium$(). At first, it might seem that it doesn't do much. However, the longer the exposure, the faster it $(bold)kills$() you.$(br)$(l:game_mechanics/hazards#gloves)Gloves$() and the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$() provide protection from $(thing)Berylliosis$().

pages.title: CO Poisoning
pages.text: $(thing)Carbon Monoxide Poisoning$() is an illness caused by inhaling $(thing)Carbon Monoxide$() gas. Prolonged exposure causes nausea and quick $(bold)death$().$(br)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#mask)Face Mask$() and the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$() provide protection from $(thing)Carbon Monoxide$().

pages.title: Carcinogens
pages.text: $(thing)Carcinogens$() are substances that cause $(item)Cancer$(). They include $(thing)Chromium Dust$() aswell as some organic compounds, such as Benzene and its products. $(thing)Carcinogens$() don't go away on their own, but they give plenty of warnings before doing any real harm. It starts off with Weakness, followed by Hunger, then Slowness and later on Mining Fatique. Only when substantial enough exposure is accumulated it causes $(bold)Death$().

pages.title: Carcinogens
pages.text: The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#mask)Face Mask$() protects from inhalation of harmful chemicals, while the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#gloves)Gloves$() protect from contact with $(thing)Chromium Dust$().$(br)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$() protects from both.$(br)In case of severe exposure, it is advised to take some $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#medicine)Medicines$() to $(thing)Prevent$() any possible damage.

pages.title: Chemical Burns
pages.text: $(thing)Chemical burns$() are caused by inhalation or skin contact with certain $(thing)Gases$(), $(thing)Acids$(), $(thing)Bases$() or $(thing)Dusts$(). Exposure causes $(item)Weakness$().$(br)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#mask)Face Mask$() protects from inhalation, while the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#gloves)Gloves$() protects from direct skin contact.$(br)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$() protects from everything.

pages.title: Irritants
pages.text: $(thing)Irritation$() is caused by inhalation of $(thing)Ammonium Formate$() or skin contact with $(thing)Chromite Dust$(). Short contact only causes Weakness, but if ignored for longer it starts $(item)Damaging Randomly$().$(br)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#mask)Face Mask$() protects from inhalation, while the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#gloves)Gloves$() protects from direct skin contact.$(br)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$() protects from both.

pages.title: Methanol Poisoning
pages.text: $(thing)Methanol poisoning$() is caused by inhalation of $(thing)Methanol$(). It causes a strong $(item)Blindness$() effect.$(br)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#mask)Face Mask$() and the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$() protects from inhalation.

pages.title: Nauseating Chemicals
pages.text: $(thing)Nauseating chemicals$(), such as $(thing)Butyraldehyde$(), are substances that cause $(item)Nausea$() when inhaled.$(br)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#mask)Face Mask$() and the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$() protect from inhalation.

pages.title: Poisonous Materials
pages.text: There are two types of $(thing)Poisonous materials$(). Weak include $(thing)Lead Dust$(), while the stronger poisons include $(thing)Nitrogen Dioxide$(). $(thing)Weak poisons$() cause a $(item)Progressively Worsening Poison$() effect, while $(thing)Regular poisons$() cause Weakness and a Stronger Poison effect.$(br)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#mask)Face Mask$() protects from inhalation, while the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#gloves)Gloves$() protects from direct skin contact.$(br)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$() protects from any contact.

pages.title: Silicosis
pages.text: $(thing)Silicosis$() is an illness caused by inhaling $(thing)Silicon Dioxide Dust$(). Exposure causes a $(item)Reduction$() in both $(item)Health$() and the $(item)Air Supply$() you have while diving $(thing)Under Water$().$(br2)The $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#mask)Face Mask$() and the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$() provide protection from inhalation of silicon dioxide.

pages.title: Radioactive Materials
pages.text: Most $(thing)Radioactive substances$() like $(thing)Uranium 238$() you will only meet at $(thing)EV tier$() or above. They will $(item)Permanently Irradiate$() you. Small exposure causes glowing, but prolonged contact triggers a quick $(bold)Death$().$(br)We know it looks tasty and has a billion calories, but $(#ff0000)PLEASE DO NOT EAT URANIUM!$()

pages.title: Radioactive Materials
pages.text: Only the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#hazmat)Hazmat Suit$(), as well as some advanced armors provide full protection from radiation.$(br)In the case you do get irradiated, only the $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#rad_away)RadAwayᵗᵐ Pill$() can cure you.
